Bright, flowing streams of colored water move continuously through these tunnels, traversing the entire visible network. As the water moves, it leaves behind visible, earthy deposits of sediment and mineral buildup. This residue accumulates most thickly at every junction and bend in the paths, creating a rich, dynamic tapestry of flow and residue that maps the complex geology of the hidden system.
